notes.title: Update 0.3.86 | Bug-Fixes | Flashlight
notes.content:
1. Collision changes:

 Jumping on the truck should no longer be possible.
 Jumping on the power boxes by the stairs to the subway is no longer possible
 The boost machines now have a collision box which should prevent jumping on them
 The gap in the fence between the main building and the shed now has a larger collision box.
 The broken wall behind the shed now has a wider collision box
 The blue tarpaulin that covers the car now has a collision box over it, which prevents jumping on it
 The green garbage can behind the gas station now has a collision box over it, which prevents jumping on it.



2. Perk:

 If you die, all perk icons will be reset and the character values ​​will be reset to the default
 All perks can now be bought at the dealer (previously only 2xHP, Regeneration Boost and Movement Speed)
 Prices at the dealer have been increased


3. Attachment:

 At the request of some players, I added a flashlight as a test.
 This attachment relates to the character and not to the weapon itself.
 If this attachment is bought from the dealer, the flashlight can be used for all other weapons.
 New entry in the keyboard layout. Look in the settings -> Default: "L"


Other fixes:

 The light cone no longer shines through the wall
 (Map: 2035) The two doors in the start building now have a collision box that prevents jumping through.
 (Map: 2035) Zombies should now spawn faster
 Buying ammunition (buying the same weapon) should now work reliably and costs half the price of the weapon


Changes:

 New weapons have been added to the seller:
2 x sniper rifles, 1 x grenade launcher
 Pistols can now also be equipped with the red dot sight and the circle sight
 The zoom of the sights has been changed and so hopefully have more use.

notes.title: Update 0.3 | Map | Animations | Weapon | Quickstart
notes.content:
New:

Menu function: "Quickstart":
Via the menu item Quickstart, the player can now play with other players in multiplayer with just one click.
The function automatically searches for games with the status "Lobby" and joins the current game if a slot is available.
If no slot is available in a lobby, a new lobby is automatically hosted and made available to others.

New map: "The Tracks 2035":
This new map is the future version of the old "The Tracks" map.
In order to play this new map, a few tasks must be completed in the previous map.


Changes:

- Zombies now make additional noises (for example: footsteps sounds)
- The oil barrels: (New explosion sounds, new visual effects, can set zombies on fire and cause damage)
- Boost machines: (There is now a separate machine for each boost, machines always spawn randomly, boosts stay on for the entire game)
- Automatic opening of the character selection when entering the lobby
- New icons for the boosts
- Changes to the HUD
- Font changes in the main menu
- Grenades now have a white ring around them for better visibility
- Changes to the arm and weapon models

notes.title: Update 0.2.0 | Multiplayer | New Weapons | Big Update
notes.content:
Deadly Land has been redesigned from the ground up and now offers the opportunity to play in co-op mode. Fight the creepy zombie waves with up to 3 other people.
It is also possible to play in single player mode.

[previewyoutube=JPi2eHMw1mo;full][/previewyoutube]

New:

 Multiplayer mode for up to 4 players
 Zombie Bosses
 New Weapons
 New Animations
 New Damage-System
 Character Selection
 Extended Zombie Movement-System
 Chat
 Dealer for Weapons, Weapon-Upgrades, etc
 Possibility to boost your Attributes
 Resuscitation System


Has been removed from the game or temporarily disabled:

 Skins
 Steam Achievements
 Possibility to play “The Tracks” on “Sunny day”
 Flare Gun for the Air Drop
 Walki-Talki for Air-Support


Changes copared to Beta 0.2.0:

 Changes to the map(Collisions)
 Movement speed from the bosses has been minimized
 Explosion damage from the boss with the bomb has been reduced so far that a player does not necessarily die if the distance to the boss is far enough.
 In order to improve the performance in multiplayer, a lot multiplayer stuff has been optimized.
 "Shop system" -> A black market dealer appears at a random location and stays there for a certain time. This dealer offers random weapons, attribute enhancements, and weapon enhancements for purchase.
 Objects with which you can interact are no longer completely white, but only have white edges.


Details:
Multiplayer Mode for up to 4 players: Play with up to 3 other players in co-op mode. Prove your ability to work in a team or compare yourself to other players and get the most zombie kills. When creating a server, you have the option to protect your server with a password, so you can decide whether you only play with your friends or with other people.
Zombie Bosses: Every zombie boss has his own strengths. (There are currently two different bosses, more bosses are still being implemented)
Sheet Metal Boss: A zombie who wears sheet metal protection. Each one of the 12 pieces of sheet metal reduces the damage you do. Try to destroy the plates by targeting them.
Bomb Boss: This zombie has a time bomb on his body. Make sure you don't shoot it. Ideally aim at the zombie's head. If you and your team take too long, the bomb goes off. The damage from this bomb is so high that it deducts 90% of your full life.
New Damage-System: weapon damage now scales to the distance to the target. If you are close enough to the enemy, the weapon does 100% damage. The damage decreases with increasing distance.
Character Selection: For the multiplayer mode it is of course necessary that each player has a whole body. This "third person body” is shown to the other players. You cannot see your own" third person body ". Choose one of 8 characters.
Extended Zombie Movement-System: Hits on the legs or arms of zombies can slow them down. As these parts of the body are lost, the zombies crawl and lose speed. Use this advantage to give you enough time between the waves.
Chat: Since there is currently no voice chat, you can use the chat to make arrangements with your team members. An internal voice chat will follow in the future.
Dealer for Weapons, Weapon-Upgrades, etc: A black market dealer appears in dark areas of the map every now and then. This dealer always offers the player different goods. Weapons with different attachments or weapons that are rarely obtained from the Mystery Crate. You can also buy grenades and sights from the black market dealer.
Possibility to boost your Attributes: With these Boosts, you can improve your attributes for little money. Each attribute upgrade lasts 2 minutes and can then be purchased again. Improvements are currently the following:
Doubling of life points, improving life regeneration, faster running speed, increased projectile damage, larger magazine, faster reloading.
Resuscitation System: Help your team members when they are down and bleeding. If one of them is injured and bleeding, the others have 30 seconds to help him up. If the injured player is not helped in time, he dies and loses his weapons. The game is not over for the deceased player. If at least one player survives the wave, all dead start again in the next round.

Discord
